title: Street-Level AI: Are Large Language Models Ready for Real-World Judgments?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM prioritization decisions using pairwise comparisons of homeless household profiles to determine if models systematically favor 'vulnerability-oriented' (higher need) or 'outcome-oriented' (lower risk of service reentry) distributions, and comparing these orientations to human baselines.

Applying ordinal logistic regression to LLM-generated global rankings to identify which specific socioeconomic, behavioral, and medical features (e.g., current living arrangements, substance use, incarceration history, mental health) disproportionately drive the models' vulnerability judgments compared to established bureaucratic scoring systems.
